notes: No page states a tuition fee for non-EU/EEA students for this programme. The programme page and the institution-wide study costs page only mention the statutory (wettelijk) collegegeld, which is the EU/EEA rate, so tuition is left out. The language requirement quote does not state a CEFR level or specific tests, so it is recorded as a rule with no minimum and no accepted tests. The only document named for foreign-diploma applicants is a diploma equivalent to havo/vwo/mbo-4; no translation requirement is stated.
